app.name: SalamaLine
app.tagline: Confidential support for safety and wellbeing

auth.createSubtitle: Optional. You can use SalamaLine without an account.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.noAccount: New to SalamaLine? Create an account
auth.accountCreated: Account created. You can sign in now.
auth.staffNotice: Staff tools are not available in this app. Use the approved staff workspace.
auth.publicNotice: Your support requests stay private. You can also use the app without an account.
auth.recoveryUnavailable: Password recovery is not yet available. Use the Support screen to ask a trained person for help.

validation.displayName: Enter a name of 2 to 80 characters.

header.themeHint: Changes the app appearance and is saved on this device.

menu.title: Menu
menu.note: Quick Exit stays available on every screen.

onboarding.welcomeBody: A safe place to find reliable information, confidential support and verified services.
onboarding.introBody: Ask a question, request support from a trained person, or find a verified organisation near you.
onboarding.servicesBody: Browse verified services, track a request and learn about your rights and wellbeing.
onboarding.languageBody: You can change this at any time in Settings. We will not change it for you.
onboarding.privacyBody: Share only what is necessary. SalamaLine does not automatically contact emergency services, family or police.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language for the whole app.
language.note: Navigation, forms, messages and notifications will follow this choice.
language.deviceNote: Your choice is saved and is never changed by your device settings.

quickExit.neutralBody: This screen does not show support requests, referrals or personal information.
quickExit.returnHelp: You can continue when you are ready.
quickExit.limitation: Quick Exit moves you away from sensitive screens. It does not close the app or guarantee complete privacy.

home.subtitle: What would you like to do today?
home.getHelpBody: Tell us what is happening. A trained person will review it.
home.learnBody: Read trusted information about safety and wellbeing.
home.requestsBody: Track a request with your reference.
home.referralsBody: Understand what a referral means and how it is shared.
home.aiBody: Get grounded answers about rights and support.
home.safetyNote: If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number or a trusted adult.

support.title: Ask for confidential support
support.intro: Share only what is necessary. You can choose to remain anonymous.
support.details: Tell us only what is necessary
support.contactHint: Contact details are only stored if you clearly agree.
support.contactConsent: I agree that SalamaLine may use this contact to respond to me.
support.locationHint: Region and district help us find the right service.
support.gpsConsent: I agree to share my location with SalamaLine.
support.referenceHint: Keep this reference. Use it to check your request status.
support.consentWarning: We can only contact you if you give specific consent.
support.doneBody: A trained person will review it. Nobody is contacted automatically.

validation.contact: Add a contact or choose to send anonymously.

requests.title: Track a request
requests.intro: Enter the reference you received after sending a request.
requests.needsInfo: A responder may need more information.
requests.notFound: We could not find that reference.
requests.invalid: Enter a valid reference, for example SL-A1B2C3D4E5F60718.
requests.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
requests.referralBody: If a referral is offered, a responder will explain it through your case. SalamaLine never shares your details without specific consent.

learn.title: Learn
learn.empty: No approved resources are available yet.

services.title: Verified services
services.intro: Only active and verified services are shown.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your app preferences and safety information.
profile.logoutHint: Available when public accounts are enabled.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeBody: Light, dark, or follow your device.
settings.aiBody: Ask grounded questions about rights and support.
settings.notificationsBody: Neutral local reminders only. No confidential details are shown.
settings.privacyBody: Read how SalamaLine handles your information.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Reminders never show request details, referrals or personal information.
notifications.permissionBody: SalamaLine only sends neutral reminders. Request details are never shown.
notifications.sample: You have a new update in SalamaLine.
notifications.deepLinkHint: Opening a notification leads to a neutral screen first.
notifications.preferencesBody: Choose what you want to be reminded about. These settings are saved only on this device.
notifications.consentBody: Device notifications stay off until you agree. Messages are neutral and never show request details.
notifications.permissionDenied: Permission was not granted. In-app preferences still apply.
notifications.pushUnavailable: Server push is not available in this build. Preferences are saved locally and nothing is sent to your device.
notifications.inAppUnavailable: There are no in-app notifications yet.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and the API address.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.conflict: An account with these details already exists.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.subtitle: Choose how SalamaLine looks.
theme.note: Your choice is saved on this device only.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.subtitle: Grounded answers from approved SalamaLine information.
ai.intro: Ask a short question. Do not include names, phone numbers or other identifying details.
ai.healthError: Could not check the assistant status.
ai.askError: The assistant could not answer right now.
ai.noAnswerBody: Try a different question or ask a trained person through Support.
ai.humanSupport: A trained person may be able to help.
ai.escalate: If there is immediate danger, contact local emergency services or a trusted adult.
ai.disclaimer: This assistant shares general information only. It does not diagnose, decide, or contact anyone automatically.

suggestions.childMarriage: What is the law on child marriage in Tanzania?
suggestions.services: How can I find a verified service near me?
suggestions.education: What should I do if a girl is kept out of school?

safety.emergency: If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number or a trusted adult.
safety.confidential: Your request is reviewed by a trained person. SalamaLine does not automatically contact anyone.
safety.anonymous: You can choose to send a request without contact details.
